title: MeetMind
description: An AI-powered application that automatically extracts tasks from meeting audio recordings, assigns them to team members using intelligent skill matching, and manages deadlines, priorities, and task dependencies — transforming meeting chaos into actionable workflows.

detail.problem: In today's fast-paced business environment, 70% of meeting decisions are never implemented due to poor follow-up, costing $37 billion annually on unproductive meetings in the US alone. Teams spend hours manually transcribing meetings and identifying action items, tasks are assigned inefficiently or forgotten entirely, and complex projects suffer from unrecognized task interdependencies. The average employee spends 31 hours per month in meetings, with significant time lost to manual note-taking and task assignment.

features.title: Intelligent Audio Processing
features.description: Upload meeting audio files (.mp3, .wav, .m4a) and get automatic transcription using OpenAI Whisper, with audio preprocessing including normalization and format conversion via FFmpeg.

features.title: Smart Task Extraction
features.description: Context-aware NLP pipeline that identifies actionable items from natural conversation, extracts deadlines from temporal expressions, detects priorities (Critical/High/Medium/Low), and handles vague references using surrounding context.

features.title: Automatic Team Assignment
features.description: Multi-factor assignment algorithm that matches tasks to team members through explicit mention detection, skill-based matching, role matching, and workload balancing — with confidence scores and assignment reasoning.

features.title: Dependency Mapping
features.description: Identifies task dependencies ('depends on', 'after', 'first'), builds directed dependency graphs using NetworkX, detects cycles, and provides execution order for project planning.

architecture.description: MeetMind follows a layered processing pipeline: Audio Upload → Preprocessing → Whisper Transcription → Text Processing → Task Extraction → Enrichment (Entity Recognition, Deadlines, Priorities, Dependencies) → Skill Matching → Task Assignment → Validation. The FastAPI backend handles the complete NLP pipeline, while a Vanilla JavaScript frontend provides a modern, responsive dashboard with dual card/table view modes.

techDetails.name: FastAPI
techDetails.role: High-performance async Python backend with REST API endpoints for audio processing, team management, and task validation

techDetails.name: OpenAI Whisper
techDetails.role: State-of-the-art speech-to-text transcription — handles multiple audio formats with high accuracy

techDetails.name: NLP Pipeline
techDetails.role: Custom NLP services: task extraction, NER, deadline parsing, priority detection, and skill inference — built without heavy ML frameworks

techDetails.name: NetworkX
techDetails.role: Directed graph library for building task dependency maps, cycle detection, and topological ordering

techDetails.name: Vanilla JavaScript
techDetails.role: Zero-dependency frontend with drag-and-drop uploads, real-time processing status, filterable card/table views, and dependency graph visualization via Chart.js

results.description: MeetMind transforms meeting chaos into organized, assigned task lists in seconds. The multi-factor assignment algorithm matches tasks with confidence scores and transparent reasoning. Dual view modes (cards and tables) with priority filters make it easy for teams to track and manage their workload.

businessHighlights.description: MeetMind addresses a critical pain point in the $37B+ meeting productivity space, where valuable decisions and action items are lost in post-meeting chaos.

highlights.title: Market Opportunity
highlights.text: 70% of meeting decisions go unimplemented. MeetMind targets SMBs, tech companies, and professional services firms with limited administrative resources and high meeting frequency.

highlights.title: Competitive Edge
highlights.text: Unlike Otter.ai (transcription-only) or Fireflies.ai (basic tasks), MeetMind provides end-to-end automation: audio → transcription → task extraction → intelligent assignment with dependency mapping.

highlights.title: Value Proposition
highlights.text: Eliminates manual note-taking, prevents task loss, balances team workloads automatically, and visualizes task dependencies — saving teams hours per week on meeting follow-up.

title: Neural Style Transfer App
tagline: Transform photos into art with deep learning
description: A deep learning application that transforms photos into artistic masterpieces using neural style transfer. Features real-time preview, multiple style models, and batch processing support.

detail.problem: Artists and content creators often want to apply artistic styles to their photos but lack the technical skills or expensive software required. Existing neural style transfer tools are either slow, low-quality, or require GPU-heavy setups that aren't accessible to most users.

features.title: Real-Time Preview
features.description: Live preview of style transfer as you adjust parameters, powered by optimized inference on lightweight models.

features.title: Multiple Style Models
features.description: Pre-trained models for various artistic styles — impressionism, cubism, watercolor, and custom styles uploaded by users.

features.title: Batch Processing
features.description: Process entire photo albums with a single style, with progress tracking and background queue management.

features.title: Resolution Control
features.description: Adjustable output resolution from quick previews to print-quality 4K outputs with progressive rendering.

architecture.description: Built on a PyTorch backend with pre-trained VGG19 feature extractors for style transfer. The FastAPI server handles image upload, processing queues, and serves results. React frontend provides an intuitive drag-and-drop interface with real-time parameter controls.

techDetails.name: PyTorch
techDetails.role: Deep learning framework for neural style transfer model inference

techDetails.name: VGG19
techDetails.role: Pre-trained CNN for feature extraction and perceptual loss computation

techDetails.name: FastAPI
techDetails.role: Async API server with background task processing for batch operations

techDetails.name: React
techDetails.role: Interactive UI with drag-and-drop uploads and real-time parameter sliders

techDetails.name: Celery
techDetails.role: Distributed task queue for handling batch processing jobs

results.description: The application delivers high-quality style transfers in seconds rather than minutes, making artistic AI accessible to non-technical users. The batch processing feature has been particularly popular for social media content creators.

title: Smart Analytics Dashboard
tagline: Predictive insights powered by machine learning
description: A real-time analytics dashboard with predictive insights powered by ML models. Features interactive charts, anomaly detection, and automated report generation with natural language summaries.

detail.problem: Business teams drown in raw data but starve for actionable insights. Traditional dashboards show historical data without predictive capabilities, and anomaly detection requires dedicated data science resources that most small-to-mid companies can't afford.

features.title: Anomaly Detection
features.description: Automated detection of unusual patterns in data streams using Isolation Forest and statistical methods, with configurable sensitivity thresholds.

features.title: Predictive Forecasting
features.description: Time-series forecasting with confidence intervals, powered by ARIMA and Prophet models for accurate trend prediction.

features.title: Natural Language Reports
features.description: Auto-generated executive summaries that translate complex data patterns into plain English insights.

features.title: Interactive Visualizations
features.description: D3.js-powered charts with zoom, filter, and drill-down capabilities for deep data exploration.

architecture.description: A Next.js frontend with server-side rendering for fast initial loads and SEO. Python ML microservices handle forecasting and anomaly detection. D3.js powers custom interactive visualizations. PostgreSQL stores historical data with TimescaleDB extension for time-series optimization.

techDetails.name: Next.js
techDetails.role: SSR-enabled React framework for fast dashboard rendering and API routes

techDetails.name: D3.js
techDetails.role: Custom interactive charts with transitions, tooltips, and drill-down navigation

techDetails.name: Python ML Services
techDetails.role: Scikit-learn and Prophet models for anomaly detection and forecasting

techDetails.name: PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB
techDetails.role: Time-series optimized storage for high-frequency data ingestion

techDetails.name: WebSocket
techDetails.role: Real-time data streaming for live dashboard updates

results.description: The dashboard reduces the time from data to insight by automating the analysis pipeline. Natural language reports have made data accessible to non-technical stakeholders.
